name: drumtrainer
description: Drum trainer: practise scripted patterns on an electronic kit, timing analysed from MIDI

layout.composition: C=(1:1:1) A1=(PRE, VOI, KIT, DRP, SWG) A2=(ONF, SYNC, ANLZ, ABRS) A3=(BPM, SVOL, MVOL, IVOL)

performance-page.composition: C=(1:1) A1=(ONF, BPM, ANLZ) A2=(SWG, SVOL, MVOL, IVOL)

extra_timer_callbacks: if (const auto status = processorRef.pollAnalysisStatus()) { m_statusBar.showMessage(*status, status->isNotEmpty()); }
extra_processor_methods: [[nodiscard]] juce::String windowTitle() const { return pluginRunner ? "DrumTrainer - " + juce::String::fromUTF8(pluginRunner->displayName().c_str()) : juce::String("DrumTrainer"); }
[[nodiscard]] bool presetHasSwing(int idx) const noexcept { return pluginRunner && pluginRunner->isPresetSwing(idx); }
